research_question: At what routed row count does transferring original expert weights to the GPU become cheaper than CPU execution?

measurement_protocol.order: Serial/concurrent schedules alternate first position each repetition; curve resident/upload order alternates with row count; repeated profile/layer/row order and GPU split order reverse on the middle invocation.
measurement_protocol.statistic: Median of three per-invocation concurrent-mode medians; each candidate must pass every warm-up and measured execution in both schedules in all three invocations.
measurement_protocol.inventory_digest_recipe: SHA256 of compact sorted-key JSON array of {file: basename, sha256: file SHA256}, ordered by basename across all 150 curve/repeat files.

numerical_findings.default_auto_full_row: Rows 1/2/4 pass all partitions in the three sampled layers; wide-row fast timings are excluded where the unchanged gate fails.
numerical_findings.blackwell_mmq: Pinned CUDA MMQ source defaults MXFP4 matrix execution to Q4 activations when Blackwell MMA is available. Existing process-scoped Q8 override reduces, but does not eliminate, observed numerical differences.
numerical_findings.gpu_row_chunks: Sharing original weights across chunks of four GPU rows improves some gates without changing the full-row CPU reference, target weights or probabilities. Some cases still fail maximum-absolute and/or relative-L2 bounds.
numerical_findings.selection_warning: Passing split counts are post-hoc experimental observations for fixed experts and synthetic activations, not a safe runtime policy or evidence that other real routing weights pass.

prefill_observations.workload: Two controlled systems-design prompts, not a representative natural-workload qualification.
prefill_observations.coverage_note: Counts describe observed graph work. Zero-row pruned final-layer observations are retained; the final layer is not labeled as covering every prompt token.
prefill_observations.decode_format_regression: The ordinary decode trace passed the unchanged routing analyzer.

execution_boundary.current_prefill: Original backend path above the guarded hybrid batch limit; not a stage-aware expert-workload scheduler.
execution_boundary.weight_upload_method: optional synchronous pageable source recopy inside every timed iteration

failed_gpu_attempt.error: ggml_cuda_init: failed to initialize CUDA: unknown error; no usable GPU; no CPU-only fallback for a real hybrid probe.

limitations: No integrated stage-aware prefill scheduler, full-model speedup or broad quality qualification is established.
Every timing row selects the same four experts; real prefill routing histograms were collected separately and do not make these timing activations representative.
Repeated copies of the same source bytes do not enforce CPU cache misses.
Pageable synchronous transfers do not model pinned asynchronous DMA or a pipelined executor.
A microkernel break-even point, if later established, is not a complete-model scheduling rule.
No numerical thresholds were loosened and no missing GPU work was replaced with CPU success.
All-GPU fast timings and failing mixed splits are excluded from qualified improvements.
The fastest passing partition was selected after observing fixed synthetic cases, not qualified on new activations or arbitrary expert IDs.
Instrumented routing capture is not a latency benchmark; one matching greedy continuation token per prompt is not full-logit or answer-quality qualification.

retained_followup_failures.reason: Reduced branch used [hidden, rows, 1] while the merge expected [hidden, 1, rows]. Fixed probe layout and added explicit layout guards and CPU reconciliation regression checks.
Initial observer rejected the legitimate zero-row pruned final-layer tensor. Zero-row observations are now retained and covered by the self-test.

next_steps: Resolve batched CPU/GPU numerical differences across arbitrary expert sets and representative captured activations without relaxing thresholds.
Measure per-expert workload curves and pinned asynchronous transfer costs under cache pressure rather than extrapolating four-expert warm curves.
Expand routing observations beyond two controlled prompts and include uneven expert loads and all relevant layers.
Only then design a bounded prefill scheduling prototype that charges temporary memory, eviction and decode-residency effects.
Qualify full-model prompt throughput, time to first token, accepted-output decode rate, total request time and peak memory before promoting any policy.
